clauses: Count each advanced behaviour analysis row.
Count each distinct trade record once, even if it has multiple analyses.
readings: For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. Count each advanced behaviour analysis row.

For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. Count each distinct trade record once, even if it has multiple analyses.
queries:
SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS analysed_trade_records,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM advancedbehavior AS a
JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
GROUP BY t.tradekind

WITH analysed_trades AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.transreg, r.tradekind
    FROM advancedbehavior AS a
    JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink
    JOIN trader AS r ON r.tradereg = t.trdref
)
SELECT
    tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS trade_record_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM analysed_trades
GROUP BY tradekind
